title: M/S G.B.A. Steels & Metals Pvt. Ltd. v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip Gupta and Jayant Banerji, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed; clause 4.20 additional-security challenge fails.
headnote: A writ challenging Dakshinanchal’s 17 July 2014 demand for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is dismissed. Counsel agreed the controversy had been decided against the consumer in Dev Prayag Paper Mill (21 March 2017), which found no merit in a challenge to clause 4.20. The 4 August 2014 interim restraint is vacated.
facts: The petitioner, an industrial consumer, challenged Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.’s notice dated 17 July 2014 demanding additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 4 August 2014 a Division Bench connected the petition with Writ Petition (C) No. 51844 of 2009 and, following an interim order in Supreme Ceramics, restrained the demand. At final hearing both sides accepted that an identical challenge to clause 4.20 had already been rejected in Dev Prayag Paper Mill on 21 March 2017.

holding_units.holding: A writ challenging a demand for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is dismissed where that challenge was held to have no merit in Dev Prayag Paper Mill; any interim restraint on the demand stands vacated.
